title: Camera intrinsics (CameraInfo)
keywords: camera camerainfo calibration intrinsic intrinsics focal length principal point distortion projection matrix k d r p pixel
text: sensor_msgs/CameraInfo holds the calibration: K is the 3x3 intrinsic matrix [fx 0 cx; 0 fy cy; 0 0 1] in pixels, D the distortion coefficients (plumb_bob for most cameras), R the rectification rotation and P the 3x4 projection matrix of the rectified image. A point (X, Y, Z) in the optical frame (z forward) projects to u = fx X / Z + cx and v = fy Y / Z + cy. CameraInfo must match the image size and the camera frame_id; an uncalibrated camera leaves the matrices zero, which breaks depth and projection.
